data.title: $1,000 in Bitcoin at the 2017 Peak: What Is It Worth Now?
data.description: Buying Bitcoin at its 2017 all-time high meant watching a $1,000 investment collapse by 84% and staying underwater for three years. Whether that patience ultimately rewarded holders more than a simple index fund depends on where Bitcoin heads next.
